title: SEMA Battle of the Builders
description: BFGoodrich Young Guns winner THOMAS DICKERSON takes craftsmanship to another level with a 1967 Chevrolet C10 built almost entirely by his own hands. From its tailored chassis and hand-fabricated bed to one-off lighting, flush-mounted glass and a fully custom interior, every detail reflects a singular creative vision.

title: SEMA Battle of the Builders
description: Ron Jones reimagines the 1973 Volkswagen Thing as a coach-built, Porsche-powered off-road machine; built around a one-off chromoly long-travel chassis, the vehicle combines hand-formed body panels, more than 350 machined components and performance engineering; follow the team's journey to unite art, comfort and all-terrain capability in an original creation worthy of an off-road category victory at the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders.

title: SEMA Battle of the Builders
description: A severely deteriorated 1960 Porsche 356B becomes the foundation for an interpretation of an automotive icon; Pete Jackson and his team reshape the car with flowing body contours, balanced design details and a thoughtfully upgraded engine; see how ingenuity, symmetry and in-house craftsmanship preserve the Porsche's character while creating the sport compact/import performance category winner at the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders.

title: SEMA Battle of the Builders
description: Troy Trepanier and Rad Rides by Troy showcase "Fenderless," a scratch-built roadster based on a 1936 Ford; the custom vehicle features reengineered proportions for an open-wheel design, with the body, chassis, suspension, machined components, paint and interior all fabricated in-house; the project highlights the construction behind the custom hot rod that holds the 2025 SEMA Battle of the Builders overall title.
